description: Make evolution conditions visible to the player (GitHub issue #8). Add a pure, unit-tested helper in @ddm/shared that computes evolution progress for a monster (current stage, next stage, training current/required, elapsed/required ms, and a final-stage flag), a Japanese minutes formatter helper in the frontend, and render the progress in StatsPanel.tsx so the player can see what is needed for the next evolution and their current achievement (e.g. 'トレーニング 3/6', '経過 2分/5分'). The ultimate (完全体) stage shows a '最終段階' message. UI stays Japanese-only (i18n is separate issue #12). No new runtime dependencies.
steps: In packages/shared/src/stages.ts, add an exported interface EvolutionProgress { currentStageId: GrowthStage; currentLabelJa: string; isFinalStage: boolean; nextStageId: GrowthStage | null; nextLabelJa: string | null; trainingCurrent: number; trainingRequired: number | null; trainingMet: boolean; elapsedMs: number; requiredMs: number | null; ageMet: boolean; } and an exported pure function evolutionProgress(monster: Monster, now: number): EvolutionProgress. For the current stage use getStage(monster.stageId). If evolveRequirement is null, set isFinalStage=true, nextStageId/nextLabelJa/trainingRequired/requiredMs=null, trainingMet/ageMet=true, elapsedMs = max(0, now - monster.bornAt), trainingCurrent = monster.trainingCount. Otherwise compute nextStageId from STAGES[stageIndex+1] (and its labelJa), trainingRequired=minTrainingCount, requiredMs=minAgeMs, elapsedMs=max(0, now-bornAt), trainingMet = trainingCount >= minTrainingCount, ageMet = elapsedMs >= minAgeMs. Reuse the exact same AND-gate semantics as evolveStage so the display never contradicts the real evolution logic. Document the function with a JSDoc comment matching the file's existing style.

In packages/shared/src/__tests__/stages.test.ts, add tests for evolutionProgress using the existing T0 / MINUTE / baby() fixtures: (a) a fresh baby reports nextStageId 'rookie', nextLabelJa '成長期', trainingRequired 2, requiredMs 1*MINUTE, trainingCurrent 0, elapsedMs 0, trainingMet false, ageMet false, isFinalStage false; (b) partial progress (trainingCount 3 at now = T0 + 2*MINUTE for a rookie: trainingCurrent 3, trainingRequired 6, elapsedMs 2*MINUTE, requiredMs 5*MINUTE, trainingMet false, ageMet false) matching the issue examples; (c) a monster whose age/training satisfy the gate reports trainingMet true and ageMet true and matches evolveStage advancing; (d) an 'ultimate' monster reports isFinalStage true, nextStageId null, nextLabelJa null, trainingRequired null, requiredMs null; (e) elapsedMs is clamped to >= 0 when now < bornAt.

In packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts, add an exported pure function formatMinutesJa(ms: number): string that converts milliseconds to a whole-minute Japanese string like '2分'. Round DOWN to whole minutes (Math.floor), guard non-finite/negative input to '0分'. Keep it dependency-free and documented in the file's existing JSDoc style.
In packages/frontend/src/game-ui.test.ts, add tests for formatMinutesJa: 0 -> '0分', 60000 -> '1分', 150000 -> '2分' (floor), negative/NaN -> '0分'. Import it alongside the other ui-helpers imports.

In packages/frontend/src/components/StatsPanel.tsx, import evolutionProgress and stageLabelJa from the appropriate modules and formatMinutesJa from ../ui-helpers.ts. Compute const now = Date.now(); const prog = evolutionProgress(monster, now). Render a new block (after the existing '.train-count' paragraph) inside a <div className="evolution-progress"> with heading '進化条件'. When prog.isFinalStage is true, show a '最終段階' message (e.g. '最終段階（完全体）'). Otherwise show the next stage label and two progress lines: training as 'トレーニング {trainingCurrent}/{trainingRequired}' and elapsed time as '経過 {formatMinutesJa(elapsedMs)}/{formatMinutesJa(requiredMs)}'. Add a visual met/unmet indicator per requirement using prog.trainingMet / prog.ageMet (e.g. a '✓' when met) and a className that reflects met state so CSS can color it. Keep all text Japanese; do not add English.

In packages/frontend/src/styles.css, add styles for the new .evolution-progress block and its rows following the existing .panel / .stat-row / .train-count / --muted conventions (small font, muted color, met/unmet color cue). Do not restyle unrelated elements.
Confirm packages/frontend/src/App.tsx footer text ('進化条件: トレーニング回数 ＋ 経過時間 …') remains consistent with the new UI wording; no change required unless it conflicts.
acceptance_criteria: evolutionProgress is exported from @ddm/shared (via stages.ts re-exported by index.ts) and returns correct current/next stage, training current/required, elapsed/required ms, and isFinalStage, using the same AND-gate semantics as evolveStage.
formatMinutesJa is exported from ui-helpers.ts and formats ms to whole-minute Japanese strings with safe guards.
StatsPanel shows the next stage, 'トレーニング N/M' and '経過 X分/Y分' progress for non-final stages, and a '最終段階' message for ultimate, all in Japanese.
`npm test` (shared) passes including the new evolutionProgress tests.
`npm test -w @ddm/frontend` passes including the new formatMinutesJa tests.
`npm run build` succeeds (tsc for shared/backend/infra and tsc && vite build for frontend).
findings: Implemented evolutionProgress (packages/shared/src/stages.ts) reusing evolveStage AND-gate semantics; re-exported automatically via index.ts (export * from ./stages.ts). Added formatMinutesJa to packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts (Math.floor, guards non-finite/negative to '0分'). StatsPanel.tsx renders a .evolution-progress block after .train-count with a 進化条件 heading, '最終段階（完全体）' for ultimate, else next stage label + 'トレーニング N/M' and '経過 X分/Y分' lines with ✓ met indicator and met/unmet classNames. styles.css adds .evolution-progress styles using existing --muted/--ok/--accent conventions. App.tsx footer already consistent; no change needed. Verification: npm run build OK; npm test shared 47/47 (was 42, +5 evolutionProgress tests); npm test -w @ddm/frontend 13/13 (+1 formatMinutesJa test). All UI strings Japanese-only. No new runtime dependencies.
